roads.name: J-3
words: Properly twisty: 42 curves in 5.0 miles, about 8 a mile.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 6,843 to 7,410 ft, with 1,319 ft of up and down along the way.
Wooded nearly the whole way.
July highs average 86°F.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 1.24 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace. Most of it has no posted limit on the map, so this assumes 55 mph.
